test_title: PYST 1: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence ((Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some chips are wafers.

No wafer is a toffee.

All desserts are chips.

**Conclusions:**

I. All chips can never be toffees.

II. No dessert is a wafer.

III. Some toffees are desserts.
solution:
Statements:

Some chips are wafers.

No wafer is a toffee.

All desserts are chips.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5976c19dd4d04f29b11b2ec12db8aeca07ba5c7349ab84bd32a1aa51d2c9f594.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All chips can never be toffees. → **Follow** (Because some chips are wafers and no wafers is a toffee, which means all chips can never be toffees is definitely true)

II. No dessert is a wafer. → **Not follow** (There is no direct relation between dessert and wafer, which means it can be possible but not definitely true)

III. Some toffees are desserts. → **Not follow **(There is no direct relation between toffees and desserts, which means it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only I follow".**
